label: DuckDB
description: Query a DuckDB database file on this machine.
usage_notes: Open the file named by `database_path` with `duckdb.connect(path, read_only=True)`; never open it for writing. Install the `duckdb` package if it is missing. List the tables with `SHOW ALL TABLES`.
